effacers.m: More than one effacer. effacer: one who effaces.

effectible.m: Capable of being done or achieved.

effectives.m: More than one effective. effective: producing or capable of producing an intended result or having a striking effect.

efficacities.m: More than one efficacity. efficacity: efficacy.

effluxions.m: More than one effluxion. effluxion: the process of flowing out.
